# Savindu Thathsara

> AI & Automation Engineer in London. Builds AI-aware automation and reliable web systems. Studying BSc (Hons) Computing with Artificial Intelligence at Northumbria University, London.

Savindu Thathsara (also known online as BLSThathsara20) is a web developer and automation engineer with 7+ years of experience. He works with React, Next.js, AWS, CI/CD, Docker, Make.com, Python, and OpenAI integrations. Based in London, United Kingdom. Canonical website: https://savithathsara.me/
